FIELD.name: solution_num
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Number of the solution within the solution set

FIELD.name: ra_icrs
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Right ascension of the image center, corresponding to the current astrometric solution

FIELD.name: dec_icrs
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Declination of the image center, corresponding to the current astrometric solution

FIELD.name: fov1
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Field of view of the image along axis 1

FIELD.name: fov2
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Field of view of the image along axis 2

FIELD.name: stc_polygon
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Space-Time Coordinate (STC) representation of the image footprint in the sky. Numbers denote RA\/Dec pairs (in degrees) of four plate corners.
